name: pr4w/laravel-social-poster
description: Publish posts, carousels, videos, stories and first comments to Facebook, Instagram, Threads, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Bluesky and Pinterest from Laravel, with queue-safe retries and duplicate protection.

suggest.ext-intl: Accurate grapheme counting for Bluesky and Threads caption limits.
suggest.ext-dom: Bluesky link cards (Open Graph parsing); without it, link cards are skipped.
suggest.ext-gd: Built-in PNG/WebP to JPEG conversion (ImageConvertingTransformer) and downscaling of Bluesky link-card thumbnails.
suggest.ext-imagick: Alternative backend for the built-in image conversion and link-card thumbnail downscaling.
suggest.pr4w/laravel-social-tokens: OAuth token storage and refresh; plugs in through the CredentialsResolver hook.
